label: good
issue: median() is wrong for an even count: median([4, 1, 3, 2]) returns 3, but the median of an even number of values is the mean of the two middle values (2.5).
commit: Fix the median of an even count
diff:
--- a/stats.py
+++ b/stats.py
@@ -7,4 +7,5 @@
 
 def median(xs):
     s = sorted(xs)
-    return s[len(s) // 2]  # the issue: for an even count this isn't the middle of the two middle values
+    mid = len(s) // 2
+    return s[mid] if len(s) % 2 else (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
